item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: flap
  • 発売日: 2010-12-10

  • 日本語名: 幽霊と恋したい！
  • 英語名: Yuurei to Koi Shitai!

あらすじ

Kouichi doesn’t believe in the supernatural, even if it appears before his very eyes. He has an osananajimi, Aoi, who treats him roughly all the time, but he doesn’t mind it. One day, his house burned down and he was forced to move. However, his new home is haunted by a ghost, Nana. Kouichi isn’t fazed at all and actually tells her to just sit and be quiet. One hour later, it’s Nana that ends up pleading for him to let her stay with him. Aoi hears about this and isn’t happy at all. What will happen to this strange 3-way relationship?

item.description:

  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: かみたま
  • 英語名: Kamitama

あらすじ

Koji is just a university student. But one day, an angel, Chamu, suddenly appears in his room. According to her, there is an egg of God in his testicles. But how can you take it out? Chamu smiles and tries to cut his testicles with a sickle. Setsuna, who lives below his room, comes to his room in anger, “What the hell are you doing!?” Koji and Chamu explain what’s happened to them. Setsuna listens to it and says, “You just ejaculate!” Koji tries to run away, but a poisonous tail of Setsuna strikes his neck…. As a matter of fact, Setsuna is a devil. “I’ve finally found where the egg is!” Setsuna takes off his clothes…. Chamu soon cuts in because she doesn’t want to lose the egg. Like this, an epic battle for the egg starts….

  • 英語名: Uruwashi no Kimi Anata no Naka ni Sasagu

别名

  • 麗しの君～貴女の膣内（なか）に捧ぐ～

あらすじ

“I wanna date her….” Takuma is in love with Shiori. One day, Elena, a dropout succubus, suddenly appears in front of him and says, “I’ll give you a hand.” It seems if she fails this time, she will be expelled from her world. Takuma knows it is not fair, but he asks her to help him. Like this, he starts dating Shiori, who is beautiful, smart, and good at sports, and enjoys his school life. Any dream, however, ends sometime soon. What will happen to Takuma, Shiori, and Elena…?

item.title: Henshin Kanojo ~Haruka ga ○○ ni Kigaetara~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: flap
  • 発売日: 2008-08-22
  • スコア: 6.25/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: へんしん彼女～はるかが○○に着替えたら～
  • 英語名: Henshin Kanojo Haruka ga ○○ ni Kigaetara

あらすじ

Shunichi and Haruka used to be good old friends, but they gradually grew apart…. Several years later, Haruka becomes pretty and is liked by every student. On the other hand, Shunichi is a cosplay maniac now. He really wants to become friends with her again, but he can’t do that. But one day, Shunichi’s parents and Haruka’s parents go on a trip and Haruka stays at Shunichi’s house for several days. He feels awkward with her at first, but she suddenly wears his maid costume and says, “Well, what’s up, my master?” Shunichi doesn’t know what to say…. She also says, “What shall I do for you, my master…?” What will happen to them…?

  • 英語名: Oyako Ninjutsu Kunoichi PonPon!!

あらすじ

During the Sengoku Era of Japan, Tsubaki is a kunoichi (female ninja). When she fails her mission and gets injured, Kotarou, the second son of the lord she was set to kill, takes her to his house and takes care of her. She is impressed with his kindness and falls in love with him. One day, another kunoichi, Kikyou, comes to his house. Actually, Kikyou is Tsubaki’s daughter. Tsubaki says to him, “Please accept Kikyou as your wife….”
